tasks.label: ef: aplicar migraciones (PostgreSQL)
tasks.command: dotnet tool run dotnet-ef database update --project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql.csproj --startup-project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql.csproj --context PortalSaasDbContext

tasks.label: ef: aplicar migraciones (SQL Server)
tasks.command: dotnet tool run dotnet-ef database update --project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer.csproj --startup-project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer.csproj --context PortalSaasDbContext

tasks.label: ef: nueva migración (PostgreSQL)
tasks.command: dotnet tool run dotnet-ef migrations add ${input:migrationName} --project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql.csproj --startup-project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.PostgreSql.csproj --context PortalSaasDbContext

tasks.label: ef: nueva migración (SQL Server)
tasks.command: dotnet tool run dotnet-ef migrations add ${input:migrationName} --project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer.csproj --startup-project src/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer/PortalSaas.Data.Migrations.SqlServer.csproj --context PortalSaasDbContext

inputs.description: Nombre de la migración nueva (PascalCase, ej. AddUsageAlerts) -- generar en los DOS motores
